title: Hosting Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server with Docker, Docker Compose and Reverse Proxy
subtitle: A
summary: A guide to seft-hosting a Minecraft server with docker and a proxy for hiding you real IP from what the web, for plaing with friend or small community.

content.text: Hosting Minecraft using Docker is the most easiest way to hosting a server to play with friend. By using Docker you eliminate the server being install on system and by using a proxy you eliminate exposting your real IP and any port being open, that could cause a security risk.
Install Docker Desktop intsall from the offical website.

Open File Exploror and move to \Document and create a Folder \MinecraftServer then create a YML file
 in the folder \MinecraftServer\docker-compose.yml

content.code:
# =====================================================================
# DOCKER COMPOSE CONFIGURATION
# Hosts: Playit.gg Agent, Minecraft Bedrock (PE), and Terraria Vanilla
# =====================================================================

services:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Playit.gg Tunneling Service
  # Maps internal ports to external URLs so friends can join without port forwarding.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  playit:
    image: ghcr.io/playit-cloud/playit-agent:0.17
    container_name: playit-agent

    # Allows Playit to directly read network ports on the host system (127.0.0.1)
    network_mode: host

    # Ensures the tunnel automatically restarts if the server reboots or crashes
    restart: unless-stopped

    environment:
      # Your unique Playit account secret key
      - SECRET_KEY=

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Minecraft Pocket Edition / Bedrock Server
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  minecraft-be:
    image: itzg/minecraft-bedrock-server:latest
    container_name: minecraft-bedrock
    restart: unless-stopped

    ports:
      # Default Minecraft Bedrock port (UDP protocol)
      - "19132:19132/udp"

    environment:
      # Required by Mojang: Must be TRUE to accept the End User License Agreement
      - EULA=TRUE

      # World and server display settings
      - SERVER_NAME=My Bedrock Server
      - GAMEMODE=survival               # Options: survival, creative, adventure
      - DIFFICULTY=hard                # Options: peaceful, easy, normal, hard
      - MAX_PLAYERS=10                 # Maximum concurrent player slots

    volumes:
      # Save worlds, player data, and logs locally in ./minecraft-data
      - ./minecraft-data:/data

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Vanilla Terraria Dedicated Server
  # Configured for a Large World with Master Mode difficulty
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  terraria:
    image: ghcr.io/beardedio/terraria:vanilla-latest
    container_name: terraria-server
    restart: unless-stopped

    # Required for interactive server execution to keep the console alive
    tty: true
    stdin_open: true

    ports:
      # Default Terraria server port (TCP protocol)
      - "7777:7777/tcp"

    volumes:
      # Mounts local ./terraria-data directory to /world inside the container
      - ./terraria-data:/world

    # Command-line arguments passed directly to the Terraria executable
    command: >
      -world /world/MyWorld.wld
      -autocreate 3
      -worldname MyWorld
      -seed fortheworthy
      -difficulty 2
      -maxplayers 8
